Answer: C
Reason: The sequence shows initial bilateral diffuse alveolar infiltrates (Figure 1) that progress to more consolidated opacities (Figure 3), followed by significant resolution by day 4 (Figures 4a and 4b). This rapid clearance of pulmonary infiltrates is characteristic of exercise-induced pulmonary haemorrhage (EIPH), distinguishing it from infectious or cardiogenic causes which typically resolve more slowly or require specific treatment.
